```lean
import Mathlib
open Nat

/-- The least positive integer `n` such that `77` divides `(n + 2) * (n + 3)`.
Must be a numeric literal. -/
abbrev p07_answer : ℕ := 19

/-- `p07_answer` is the least element of the set of positive `n` with
`77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)`. -/
theorem p07_least_divisible :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} p07_answer := by
  refine ⟨?mem, ?least⟩
  · -- `p07_answer` belongs to the set
    have hpos : (0 : ℕ) < 19 := by decide
    have hdiv : 77 ∣ (19 + 2) * (19 + 3) := by
      norm_num
    exact ⟨hpos, hdiv⟩
  · -- any other element is at least `p07_answer`
    intro n hn
    rcases hn with ⟨hnpos, hndiv⟩
    by_contra hlt
    have hlt' : n < 19 := Nat.not_le.mp hlt
    have hle18 : n ≤ 18 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt'
    have : False := by
      -- we check all possibilities `0 ≤ n ≤ 18`
      interval_cases hle18
      all_goals
        have : ¬ (77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)) := by
          norm_num
        exact this hndiv
    exact (not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt')).elim
```
